figurative_meaning_en: extremely imminent or about to happen
example_sentences_in_bangla: বৃষ্টি হয়-হয় করছে, ছাতা নিয়ে বের হও।
পরীক্ষার ফলাফল হয়-হয়, এখনই ঘোষণা হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: The rain is about to pour, take an umbrella.
The exam results are imminent, they will be announced any moment.
note: Commonly used in contexts describing impending weather or events in everyday Bengali speech.
